title: Bushfire Relief Fundraising at the APT Travel Group
author: Aaron
body:
2019 marked the beginnings of the worst bushfire season Australia has seen in decades. Entire towns have been destroyed, half a billion animals affected and more than 7.3 million hectares of land burned.

In support of bushfire relief, a number of staff fundraising events were held at the APT Travel Group on 15th January 2020. These included a second-hand clothing recycle boutique, a sausage sizzle lunch, raffle prizes and gold coin donations.

Contributions through these events were matched by the APT Foundation, garnering some fantastic end results.

$10,100 was raised in just a single day, thanks to the generosity of staff donations and the matched the APT Foundation funding.

In addition to the $132,000 which had previously been donated by the APT Travel Group and the APT Foundation, this brings us to an outstanding contribution of $143,100 towards bushfire relief.

The generosity and dedication shown by the APT Travel Group's staff towards this cause has been uplifting, and the APT Foundation would like to recognise everyone who was involved in the effort.
